prose: A beta toolchain for AI-assisted PCB design in KiCad 10, with an MCP server. The project adds a web-research MCP server called Nimrod, offering scored Google search and clean page extraction for realtime research. It says the core is tested but needs real-world use and review.
highlights: Beta AI toolchain for KiCad 10 PCB design.
Adds a web-research MCP server, Nimrod.
